description: Typed corpus-ipc stimulus stream for the in-process runs. One StimulusBatch frame (schema corpus-ipc.stimulus.v1) is sent on every tick, idle ticks included. Ticks with modulators also get one IpcMessage::Neuromodulators frame. The cycle below repeats `cycles` times.

variants.zeroed: every masked slot (valid_mask false) gets value 0.0 and mask true; must give the same raster as main
variants.unmasked: valid_mask removed, so the 1.0 placeholder in channel 2 is applied; must differ from main (proves the mask check is not vacuous)

transport.probe_channel_rule: probe p stimulates channel p mod 8 for one frame; all other channels 0.0, mask all true
